description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Model::RecipeImporter' class, which encapsulates the business logic for importing recipes into a different project within the Coocook application. It manages attributes related to projects, recipes, ingredients, and related articles and units, and provides methods for identifying candidate matches and importing data.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::RecipeImporter
classes.description: A class implementing the business logic for importing recipes into a different project, including attribute definitions, data fetching, candidate identification, and data import methods.

methods.name: _build_ingredients
methods.description: Builds and returns the sorted ingredients of the recipe.

methods.name: _build_source_articles
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of source articles related to the recipe's ingredients.

methods.name: _build_source_units
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of source units related to the recipe's ingredients.

methods.name: _build_target_articles
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of target articles from the project.

methods.name: _build_target_units
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of target units from the project.

methods.name: BUILD
methods.description: Initializes the ingredient hashrefs with linked article and unit data based on source IDs.

methods.name: identify_candidates
methods.description: Identifies candidate matching articles and units between source and target, updating each source row with a target candidate if a unique match is found.

methods.name: import_data
methods.description: Performs the import of the recipe and its ingredients into the target project, creating new recipe and ingredient records within a transaction.
